messages:
maria: opened PR #4128 to revert the connpool change (revert 9f2a3ab). after the 09:12 deploy we've been seeing a ~20ms p50 bump across gateways. PR is a targeted revert + extra logging. can someone take a look and merge if tests pass? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4128 :pray:
ajay: on it. can you paste the perf graph and any error traces? also note if there are any migrations this touches — we should avoid a breaking rollout during EOD window
maria: perf graph: https://grafana/redwood/dashboard/connpool-p50 (link)
trace snippet pasted below — timeouts on backend calls increased after deploy. also no DB migrations in this change.
```diff
- // connpool: enable optimistic conn re-use
- if (reuse) { reuseConn(); }
+ // reverted to previous stable behavior
+ if (always_create) { createConn(); }
```
sam: i'll spin a quick canary against staging and run the usual perf harness. if staging looks ok we can merge + 5m canary in prod. who's available to watch logs?
lee: in standup for ~20m, will review after. ping me in 20 and i'll check the PR and logs.
ajay: quick code notes: logic looks fine but missing a unit for the reopen path — add a test asserting connections aren't dropped under retry. otherwise :+1: on revert semantics.
maria: added test + small fix, pushed. CI kicked off. thanks ajay.
ci-bot: build 4128 — tests passed (unit/integration) 
ajay: nice. lgtm. please don't auto-merge — coordinate canary window.
maria: merging now and will start a 5m canary. tagging @sam and @lee to watch. merging -> revert-4128 at 1868890001
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for revert-4128 (canary id: c-2024032020). routing 5% for 5m.
sam: watching logs — no error-rate increases, p50 back to baseline on canary nodes.
lee: saw a slight p95 blip ~90s after canary start (small spike, nothing sustained). p50 looks back to normal.
ajay: good catch on p95 — worth an eye during the full rollout but ok to proceed. :thumbsup:
maria: rolling to full now — will monitor. thanks everyone. :tada:
deploy-bot: full rollout complete for revert-4128. no rollout blockers reported.
maria: closing the loop — metrics stable for 10m post-rollout. will leave the extra logging in place for another 24h, then remove. thanks all for quick reviews and watches.
